docs.title: Identity & Display
docs.text:
• entry - Unique item template ID.
  • patch - Content patch (progression) this version applies to.
  • class - Item class; see the Item Class table below.
  • subclass - Sub-class within the class; meaning depends on class (weapon types for class 2, armor types for class 4, ...).
  • name - Item name.
  • description - Flavor text shown in gold on the tooltip.
  • display_id - Model/icon display row.
  • quality - Colour tier: 0 Poor (grey), 1 Common (white), 2 Uncommon (green), 3 Rare (blue), 4 Epic (purple), 5 Legendary (orange), 6 Artifact.

docs.title: Item Class
docs.text:
class (with subclass) drives behaviour and stats. From enum ItemClass (src/game/Objects/ItemPrototype.h):

Value Class Notes 0 CONSUMABLE food, potions, scrolls 1 CONTAINER bags (ContainerSlots) 2 WEAPON subclass selects type; damage block applies 3 GEM defined in the enum but unused in vanilla content 4 ARMOR cloth...shield; armor/stat block applies 5 REAGENT spell components 6 PROJECTILE ammo (bows/guns) 7 TRADE_GOODS crafting materials 8 GENERIC misc non-trade goods 9 RECIPE recipes/books teaching crafts 10 MONEY coin objects 11 QUIVER ammo pouches; ranged haste 12 QUEST quest items; add flag 0x8000 NO_DISENCHANT so they cannot be disenchanted 13 KEY permanent keys 14 PERMANENT durable non-equippables 15 JUNK vendor trash

docs.title: Economy & Stacking
docs.text:
• flags - Item flag bitmask; see the table below.
  • buy_count - How many items one vendor purchase delivers.
  • buy_price - Vendor price in copper (total for buy_count).
  • sell_price - Vendor refund per item in copper.
  • max_count - Maximum count a player may carry/own ("Unique"); 0 = unlimited.
  • stackable - Maximum stack size.

docs.title: Flags (ItemPrototypeFlags)
docs.text:
Flag Name Effect 0x00000001 NO_PICKUP not used by the core 0x00000002 CONJURED conjured item (vanishes on logout unless stored) 0x00000004 LOOTABLE right-click to open for loot (non-container) 0x00000008 EXOTIC not used in pre-3.x content 0x00000010 DEPRECATED renders with a red icon (like a zero-durability item) 0x00000020 INDESTRUCTIBLE cannot be destroyed except as a spell reagent (totems) 0x00000040 PLAYERCAST usable by players ("usable" old note) 0x00000080 NO_EQUIP_COOLDOWN no cooldown when equipping 0x00000100 INTBONUSINSTEAD int bonus displayed instead of another stat 0x00000200 WRAPPER gift-wrapped package state 0x00000400 IGNORE_BAG_SPACE created without checking bag space 0x00000800 PARTY_LOOT item is party loot 0x00001000 BRIEFSPELLEFFECTS not used in pre-3.x 0x00002000 CHARTER guild charter item 0x00004000 HAS_TEXT readable item with text pages 0x00008000 NO_DISENCHANT cannot be disenchanted 0x00010000 REAL_DURATION duration ticks in real time 0x00020000 NO_CREATOR last flag used in 1.12.1 0x00080000 UNIQUE_EQUIPPED server-side unique-equipped check

Source: enum ItemPrototypeFlags, src/game/Objects/ItemPrototype.h.

docs.title: Slot & Requirements
docs.text:
• inventory_type - Where it equips (non-equippable, head, neck, chest... two-handed weapons use their weapon subclass logic).
  • allowable_class - Class bitmask; -1 = any class.
  • allowable_race - Race bitmask; -1 = any race.
  • item_level - Item level (drives stat budget / disenchant results).
  • required_level - Minimum character level to equip/use.
  • required_skill - Skill line required (e.g. enchanting for rods).
  • required_skill_rank - Value of that skill line required.
  • required_spell - Spell that must be known (e.g. riding, dual wield).
  • required_honor_rank - PvP rank requirement.
  • required_city_rank - City reputation rank requirement (unused in vanilla content).
  • required_reputation_faction / required_reputation_rank - Faction standing gate.

docs.title: Container / Bag Fields
docs.text:
• container_slots - Number of slots (bags only).
  • bag_family - Bag family bits (herb/soul/enchanting bags restrict contents).

docs.title: Stats
docs.text:
Ten paired slots. stat_type uses ItemModType: 0 Mana · 1 Health · 3 Agility · 4 Strength · 5 Intellect · 6 Spirit · 7 Stamina (value 2 is unused).

  • stat_type1 - Stat id for slot 1.
  • stat_value1 - Amount of that stat.
  • stat_type2 - Stat id for slot 2.
  • stat_value2 - Amount of that stat.
  • stat_type3 - Stat id for slot 3.
  • stat_value3 - Amount of that stat.
  • stat_type4 - Stat id for slot 4.
  • stat_value4 - Amount of that stat.
  • stat_type5 - Stat id for slot 5.
  • stat_value5 - Amount of that stat.
  • stat_type6 - Stat id for slot 6.
  • stat_value6 - Amount of that stat.
  • stat_type7 - Stat id for slot 7.

docs.title: Weapon Damage & Ranged
docs.text:
• delay - Attack speed in milliseconds (1000 = 1.0).
  • range_mod - Ranged range modifier.
  • ammo_type - Ammo category for projectiles.
  • dmg_min1, dmg_max1, dmg_type1 - Damage range 1: minimum, maximum and school (SPELL_SCHOOL_*).
  • dmg_min2, dmg_max2, dmg_type2 - Damage range 2: minimum, maximum and school (SPELL_SCHOOL_*).
  • dmg_min3, dmg_max3, dmg_type3 - Damage range 3: minimum, maximum and school (SPELL_SCHOOL_*).
  • dmg_min4, dmg_max4, dmg_type4 - Damage range 4: minimum, maximum and school (SPELL_SCHOOL_*).
  • dmg_min5, dmg_max5, dmg_type5 - Damage range 5: minimum, maximum and school (SPELL_SCHOOL_*).
  • block - Block value for shields.

docs.title: Armor & Resistances
docs.text:
• armor - Base armor value.
  • holy_res, fire_res, nature_res, frost_res, shadow_res, arcane_res - Resistance bonuses.

docs.title: Item Spells (slots 1-5)
docs.text:
• spellid_1 - Spell cast/granted by slot 1 (0 = empty slot).
  • spelltrigger_1 - 0 on-use, 1 on-equip aura, 2 chance-on-hit.
  • spellcharges_1 - Charges; -1 consumes the item when the last charge is used.
  • spellppmrate_1 - Procs-per-minute rate for chance-on-hit triggers.
  • spellcooldown_1 - Per-item cooldown in ms (-1 = use the spell's own cooldown).
  • spellcategory_1 / spellcategorycooldown_1 - Shared-category cooldown handling.
  • spellid_2 - Spell cast/granted by slot 2 (0 = empty slot).
  • spelltrigger_2 - 0 on-use, 1 on-equip aura, 2 chance-on-hit.

docs.title: Pages, Locks & Binding
docs.text:
• bonding - 0 none, 1 binds when picked up, 2 binds when equipped, 3 binds when used, 4/5 quest-item variants.
  • page_text - First page_text.entry for readable books.
  • page_language - Language the text is written in.
  • page_material - Visual material of book pages.
  • start_quest - Quest offered by using this item.
  • lock_id - Lock.dbc entry; opening may require lockpicking/keys.
  • material - Sound/impact material (DBC passthrough).
  • sheath - How weapons are carried on the belt/back.

docs.title: Enchants, Sets & Durability
docs.text:
• random_property - Weighted pool id in item_enchantment_template rolled at creation.
  • set_id - Item set ID from ItemSet.dbc.
  • max_durability - Maximum durability points.
  • disenchant_id - Entry in disenchant_loot_template; 0 = not disenchantable.
  • duration - Temporary-item lifetime (seconds); consumed by real-duration flags.

docs.title: Bindings to World & Food
docs.text:
• area_bound / map_bound - Restricts where the item functions.
  • food_type - Pet-diet food category (1-based bit into the pet family's food mask); determines which foods a hunter pet accepts via Pet::HaveInDiet.
  • wrapped_gift - On wrapping-paper items: the item entry the package becomes once wrapped.

docs.title: Loot Money & Cross-Faction
docs.text:
• min_money_loot / max_money_loot - Coin range rolled into item_loot_template-style openable items.
  • extra_flags - Server-side flags (ItemExtraFlags, src/game/Objects/ItemPrototype.h): 0x01 mail stationery icon/background, 0x02 ignore quest-status check when this item drops, 0x04 never obtainable by players in vanilla.
  • other_team_entry - Counterpart entry id on the opposing faction; informational only - not read by core logic (faction pairing happens through tables like player_factionchange_items).

docs.title: Field Breakdown
docs.text:
• entry - Primary Key. Unique quest ID.
  • patch - Primary Key. Client patch version.
  • Method - Quest method: 0 auto-complete, 1 disabled, 2 deliver (normal).
  • ZoneOrSort - Zone ID or sort index (negative for sorting).
  • MinLevel / MaxLevel - Level requirements.
  • QuestLevel - Quest difficulty level.
  • Type - Quest type (QuestInfo.dbc): 0 normal, 1 elite, 41 PvP, 62 raid, 81 dungeon.
  • RequiredClasses / RequiredRaces - Class/race masks.
  • RequiredSkill / RequiredSkillValue - Skill requirement.
  • RequiredCondition - Condition ID.
  • RepObjectiveFaction / RepObjectiveValue - Reputation goal.
  • RequiredMinRepFaction / RequiredMinRepValue - Minimum reputation requirement.
  • RequiredMaxRepFaction / RequiredMaxRepValue - Maximum reputation (for hostile quests).
  • SuggestedPlayers - Suggested group size.
  • LimitTime - Time limit (seconds).
  • QuestFlags - Flags.
  • SpecialFlags - Special flags (e.g., 1 repeatable, 2 exploration/event).
  • PrevQuestId / NextQuestId - Quest chain links.
  • ExclusiveGroup - Shared group (only one quest in group can be active).
  • BreadcrumbForQuestId - Lead-in quest pointing at the target quest X given here. This quest is acceptable only while X itself is takeable (it hides behind X's own prerequisites); while this breadcrumb is active/incomplete, X cannot be accepted.
  • NextQuestInChain - Next quest in chain.
  • SrcItemId / SrcItemCount - Source item required.
  • SrcSpell - Spell cast to start quest.
  • Title / Details / Objectives - Quest text.
  • OfferRewardText - Text shown when completing.
  • RequestItemsText - Text shown when turning in.
  • EndText - Final dialogue.
  • ObjectiveText1-4 - Objective descriptions.
  • ReqItemId1-4 / ReqItemCount1-4 - Required items.
  • ReqSourceId1-4 / ReqSourceCount1-4 - Required source items.
  • ReqCreatureOrGOId1-4 / ReqCreatureOrGOCount1-4 - Required kills/interactions.
  • ReqSpellCast1-4 - Required spell casts.
  • RewChoiceItemId1-6 / RewChoiceItemCount1-6 - Choice rewards.
  • RewItemId1-4 / RewItemCount1-4 - Fixed item rewards.
  • RewRepFaction1-5 / RewRepValue1-5 - Reputation rewards.
  • RewRepSpilloverMask - Bitmask over RewRepFaction1..5 indexes (bit 0 = faction 1 ... bit 4 = faction 5). A set bit disables reputation spillover from that reward faction.
  • RewXP - Experience reward.
  • RewOrReqMoney - Money reward (or cost).
  • RewMoneyMaxLevel - Max-level money reward.
  • RewSpell - Spell reward (learn spell).
  • RewSpellCast - Spell cast on completion.
  • RewMailTemplateId / RewMailDelaySecs / RewMailMoney - Mail reward.
  • PointMapId / PointX / PointY / PointOpt - Map POI for quest objective.
  • DetailsEmote1-4 / DetailsEmoteDelay1-4 - Emotes during quest details.
  • IncompleteEmote / CompleteEmote - Emotes for incomplete/complete state.
  • OfferRewardEmote1-4 / OfferRewardEmoteDelay1-4 - Emotes during reward offering.
  • StartScript - Script ID for quest start.
  • CompleteScript - Script ID for quest completion.

docs.title: Flag Bitmasks
docs.text: Values from src/game/QuestDef.h.

docs.title: QuestFlags (client-visible)
docs.text: Flag Name Effect 0x00000000 NONE no flags 0x00000001 STAY_ALIVE (not used currently) 0x00000002 PARTY_ACCEPT whole party gets a confirmation popup to accept 0x00000004 EXPLORATION (not used currently) 0x00000008 SHARABLE quest can be shared with party members (CanShareQuest) 0x00000010 - reserved / unused 0x00000020 EPIC (unused) 0x00000040 RAID (unused) 0x00000100 UNK2 - 0x00000200 HIDDEN_REWARDS rewards hidden in the offer window & quest log 0x00000400 AUTO_REWARDED auto-completes; never appears in the quest log

docs.title: SpecialFlags (server-side)
docs.text:
Set with |value syntax in DB:

Value Name Effect 1 REPEATABLE quest can be repeated (resets on completion) 2 EXPLORATION_OR_EVENT completes via area exploration, the QUEST_EXPLORED script command, or the quest-complete spell effect

Values 0x008+ (DELIVER, SPEAKTO, KILL_OR_CAST, TIMED) are internal flags computed by the core from your objective columns; never set them manually.

docs.title: Interaction With Other Systems
docs.text:
• Timed quests: LimitTime > 0 sets the countdown (internal TIMED flag).
  • Exploration completion pairs SpecialFlags = 2 with an areatrigger id in areatrigger_involvedrelation.
  • Repeatable daily/weekly rotation is driven by game events + QUEST_SPECIAL_FLAG_REPEATABLE.
  • Reward visibility for surprise rewards uses HIDDEN_REWARDS.

docs.title: Field Breakdown
docs.text:
• faction - Primary Key. Child faction whose gains spill over (faction.id).

  • faction2 - Up to four parent factions receiving spillover (faction.id).
  • rate_2 - Multiplier applied to rep gained with faction and passed on to parent N (e.g. 0.25 = 25%).
  • rank_2 - Spillover applies only while player's standing toward parent N is at or below this rank.
  • faction3 - Up to four parent factions receiving spillover (faction.id).

docs.title: Identity & Text
docs.text:
• entry - Spell ID (Spell.dbc id).
  • build - Client build this row applies to.
  • name, nameSubtext, description, auraDescription - Display text (name, subtext/rank line, tooltip body, aura tooltip). Only name and nameSubtext are read by the core; description / auraDescription are client-DBC/informational columns.
  • nameFlags, nameSubtextFlags, descriptionFlags, auraDescriptionFlags - Locale mask for the Aura Description (tooltip) text; not read by core.

docs.title: Identity Extras
docs.text: • castUI - DBC passthrough column; not read by core.

docs.title: Classification
docs.text:
• school - Base magic school: 0 physical, 1 holy, 2 fire, 3 nature, 4 frost, 5 shadow, 6 arcane.
  • category - Category id; spells sharing a category share cooldowns (e.g. all Hearthstone-like items).
  • dispel - Dispel type (enum DispelType, SpellDefines.h):
Value Name 0 NONE 1 MAGIC 2 CURSE 3 DISEASE 4 POISON 5 STEALTH 6 INVISIBILITY 7 ALL 8 SPE_NPC_ONLY 9 ENRAGE 10 ZG_TICKET - mechanic - Combat mechanic granted/inflicted (SpellDefines.h): Value Name 0 NONE 1 CHARM 2 DISORIENTED 3 DISARM 4 DISTRACT 5 FEAR 6 FUMBLE 7 ROOT 8 PACIFY 9 SILENCE 10 SLEEP 11 SNARE 12 STUN 13 FREEZE 14 KNOCKOUT 15 BLEED 16 BANDAGE 17 POLYMORPH 18 BANISH 19 SHIELD 20 SHACKLE 21 MOUNT 22 PERSUADE 23 TURN 24 HORROR 25 INVULNERABILITY 26 INTERRUPT 27 DAZE 28 DISCOVERY 29 IMMUNE_SHIELD 30 SAPPED 31 SLOW_CAST_SPEED

docs.title: Stances & Target Restrictions
docs.text:
• stances / stancesNot - Shapeshift forms required / forbidden (bitmask).
  • targets - Extra target mask (e.g. corpse targets).
  • targetCreatureType - Only affects creatures of this type (CreatureTypeMask).
  • requiresSpellFocus - Requires a nearby spell-focus object (gameobject_template type 8 objects).
  • casterAuraState / targetAuraState - Caster/victim must have this aura state.

docs.title: Timers & Cooldowns
docs.text:
• castingTimeIndex - Row in CastTime.dbc (cast duration).
  • recoveryTime - Cooldown (ms) before the same spell may be recast.
  • categoryRecoveryTime - Cooldown applied to the whole category.
  • interruptFlags / auraInterruptFlags / channelInterruptFlags - What breaks the cast / removes auras / stops channeling (movement, damage, ...).
  • startRecoveryCategory / startRecoveryTime - Global cooldown category and time applied when the cast starts.
  • maxAffectedTargets - Hard cap on number of targets hit.

docs.title: Procs
docs.text:
• procFlags - Event mask that can trigger the proc (melee hit, spell cast, ...).
  • procChance - Proc frequency (PPM handling and flat % values).
  • procCharges - Charges consumed when the proc fires.

docs.title: Levels & Scaling
docs.text:
• maxLevel - Highest character level that may learn/receive it.
  • baseLevel - Level of the base rank.
  • spellLevel - Required level shown on tooltips / used in downranking math.

docs.title: Power Costs
docs.text:
• durationIndex - Row in SpellDuration.dbc.
  • powerType - Power consumed (enum Powers, SharedDefines.h): 0 Mana, 1 Rage, 2 Focus, 3 Energy, 4 Happiness (0xFFFFFFFE Health).
  • manaCost - Flat cost percentage/value depending on power type.
  • manCostPerLevel - Additional cost per caster level.
  • manaPerSecond / manaPerSecondPerLevel - Upkeep costs while active/channeling.
  • manaCostPercentage - Cost as % of total mana.

docs.title: Range, Speed & Stacking
docs.text:
• rangeIndex - Row in SpellRange.dbc (max/min range).
  • speed - Projectile travel speed (yards/sec); 0 = instant.
  • stackAmount - Max stacks of the produced aura.
  • modelNextSpell - DBC passthrough field; not used by the core.

docs.title: Reagents, Totems & Equipment Requirements
docs.text:
• totem1 / totem2 - Required totem items (item_template.entry; shaman spells).
  • reagent1, reagent2, reagent3, reagent4, reagent5, reagent6, reagent7, reagent8 - Consumed reagent item entries. (see item_template.entry)
  • reagentCount1, reagentCount2, reagentCount3, reagentCount4, reagentCount5, reagentCount6, reagentCount7, reagentCount8 - Amount for the matching reagent.
  • equippedItemClass / equippedItemSubClassMask / equippedItemInventoryTypeMask - Weapon/armor requirements for combat procs (-1 = any).

docs.title: Effects 1-3
docs.text:
Each effect slot has the same set of columns:

  • effect1 / effect2 / effect3 - Effect type (SPELL_EFFECT_*), see the Effect Types table below.
  • effectDieSides1 / effectDieSides2 / effectDieSides3 - Random dice portion of the magnitude.
  • effectBaseDice1 / effectBaseDice2 / effectBaseDice3 - Base die count.
  • effectDicePerLevel1 / effectDicePerLevel2 / effectDicePerLevel3 - Dice added per caster level.
  • effectRealPointsPerLevel1 / effectRealPointsPerLevel2 / effectRealPointsPerLevel3 - Flat points added per caster level.
  • effectBasePoints1 / effectBasePoints2 / effectBasePoints3 - Base value (dice roll is added to this).
  • effectBonusCoefficient1 / effectBonusCoefficient2 / effectBonusCoefficient3 - Spell-power coefficient.
  • effectMechanic1 / effectMechanic2 / effectMechanic3 - Mechanic applied by this effect.
  • effectImplicitTargetA1, effectImplicitTargetA2, effectImplicitTargetA3, effectImplicitTargetB1, effectImplicitTargetB2, effectImplicitTargetB3 - Target selection rules (TARGET_* ids from Spell.dbc).
  • effectRadiusIndex1 / effectRadiusIndex2 / effectRadiusIndex3 - Row in SpellRadius.dbc.
  • effectApplyAuraName1 / effectApplyAuraName2 / effectApplyAuraName3 - Aura applied by the effect (SPELL_AURA_*).
  • effectAmplitude1 / effectAmplitude2 / effectAmplitude3 - Tick interval for periodic auras (ms).
  • effectMultipleValue1 / effectMultipleValue2 / effectMultipleValue3 - Multiplier for combo-point/hot scaling values.
  • effectChainTarget1 / effectChainTarget2 / effectChainTarget3 - Additional targets hit by chaining.
  • effectItemType1 / effectItemType2 / effectItemType3 - Item created (CREATE_ITEM) or loot item (for some effects).
  • effectMiscValue1 / effectMiscValue2 / effectMiscValue3 - Generic per-effect payload (faction id, aura slot, school...).
  • effectTriggerSpell1 / effectTriggerSpell2 / effectTriggerSpell3 - Spell triggered/taught/applied by this effect (spell_template.entry).
  • effectPointsPerComboPoint1 / effectPointsPerComboPoint2 / effectPointsPerComboPoint3 - Value added per combo point.

docs.title: Visuals, Icons & Family
docs.text:
• spellVisual1 / spellVisual2 - Cast visual ids (SpellVisual.dbc); spellVisual2 is skipped by the core (not used).
  • spellIconId / activeIconId - Tooltip/action icons.
  • spellPriority - Aura display priority.
  • spellFamilyName / spellFamilyFlags - Class/family identification used by procs and talent interactions.
  • minTargetLevel / maxTargetLevel - Target level restrictions.
  • dmgClass - Damage class: 0 none, 1 magic, 2 melee, 3 ranged.
  • preventionType - What blocks casting: 0 none, 1 Silence, 2 Pacify (SPELL_PREVENTION_TYPE_*).
  • stanceBarOrder - Position in the shapeshift bar (DBC passthrough; not read by the core).

docs.title: Misc & Server Fields
docs.text:
• dmgMultiplier1, dmgMultiplier2, dmgMultiplier3 - Per-effect damage multiplier (e.g. AoE falloff).
  • minFactionId / minReputation - Reputation requirement for the spell to work (DBC passthrough; not read by the core).
  • requiredAuraVision - Caster needs an aura allowing them to see stealth/invisible targets of this kind (DBC passthrough; not read by the core).
  • customFlags - Server-side flags loaded into SpellEntry::Custom (SPELL_CUSTOM_*, SpellDefines.h: allow stacking between casters, fixed damage, ignore armor, separate aura per caster...).
  • script_name - C++ spell script binding (Scripts Library); also referenced from spell_script_target setups.

docs.title: Proc Behaviour
docs.text:
• procFlags: event mask (melee/ranged swing or ability dealt & taken, spell cast, kill, heartbeat tick...), bits defined as PROC_FLAG_* in src/game/Spells/SpellDefines.h.
  • procChance, procCharges: frequency & charge consumption.
  • Detailed triggers: spell_proc_event.

docs.title: spell_threat Table
docs.text: Defines threat values for spells - how much threat they generate.

docs.title: Schema Summary
docs.text: Field Type Key Null Default Extra entry smallint(5) unsigned PRI NO threat float NO 0 multiplier float NO 1 inverse_effect_mask tinyint(3) unsigned NO 0 build_min smallint(4) unsigned PRI NO 0 build_max smallint(4) unsigned PRI NO 5875

docs.title: Field Breakdown
docs.text:
• entry - Primary Key. Spell ID. (see spell_template.entry)
  • threat - Base threat value.
  • multiplier - Threat multiplier.
  • inverse_effect_mask - Bitmask over effect indexes (1 = effect 1, 2 = effect 2, 4 = effect 3): effects with their bit set are excluded from the flat threat value.
  • build_min / build_max - Client build range.

docs.title: taxi_nodes Table
docs.text: Defines taxi (flight master) nodes - location and mount creature IDs.

docs.title: Schema Summary

docs.title: Field Breakdown
docs.text:
• id - Primary Key. Node ID.
  • build - Primary Key. Client build.
  • map_id - Map ID.
  • x - Node position in world space.
  • y - Node position in world space.
  • z - Node position in world space.
  • name - Node name.
  • mount_creature_id1 - Creature template entry of the flying mount display used at this node (Horde variant). (see creature_template.entry)
  • mount_creature_id2 - Alliance variant mount creature for the node.

docs.title: taxi_path_transitions Table
docs.text: Defines transitions between taxi paths - connects paths and nodes.

docs.title: Schema Summary
docs.text: Field Type Key Null Default Extra in_path mediumint(8) unsigned PRI NO 0 out_path mediumint(8) unsigned PRI NO 0 in_node mediumint(8) unsigned NO 0 out_node mediumint(8) unsigned NO 0 comment text YES build_min smallint(4) unsigned NO 0

docs.title: Field Breakdown
docs.text:
• in_path - Primary Key. Incoming taxi path id (from TaxiPath.dbc).
  • out_path - Primary Key. Outgoing taxi path id (from TaxiPath.dbc).
  • in_node - Node id in the incoming path where the transition occurs.
  • out_node - Destination node (taxi_nodes).

  • build_min - Minimum build.

docs.title: transports Table
docs.text: Defines transport vehicles (e.g., ships, zeppelins) with their path period and name.

docs.title: Schema Summary
docs.text: Field Type Key Null Default Extra entry mediumint(8) unsigned PRI NO 0 build smallint(5) unsigned PRI NO 0 name text YES period mediumint(8) unsigned NO 0

docs.title: Field Breakdown
docs.text:
• entry - Primary Key. Transport entry ID — references gameobject_template.entry of type MO_TRANSPORT; other entries are rejected at load.
  • build - Primary Key. Client build.
  • name - Transport name.
  • period - Round-trip duration override (milliseconds). The core computes a period from the client taxi path; a non-zero value here replaces it. 0 keeps the computed value.

docs.title: Field Breakdown
docs.text:
• index - Primary Key. Variable key.
  • value - Variable value.

docs.title: warden_scans Table
docs.text: Defines Warden scans - anti-cheat checks for client memory modifications.

docs.title: Schema Summary
docs.text: Field Type Key Null Default Extra id smallint(5) unsigned PRI NO auto_increment type int(11) YES 0 str text YES data text YES address int(11) YES 0 length int(11) YES 0 result tinytext NO flags mediumint(8) unsigned NO penalty tinyint(4) NO -1 build_min smallint(5) unsigned NO 5875 build_max smallint(5) unsigned NO 5875 comment tinytext NO

docs.title: Field Breakdown
docs.text:
• id - Auto-increment primary key.
  • type - Windows scan type (WindowsScanType, WardenScan.hpp):
Value Scan 0 READ_MEMORY - compare client memory bytes 1 FIND_MODULE_BY_NAME - detect loaded cheat modules 2 FIND_MEM_IMAGE_CODE_BY_HASH - hash memory-image code 3 FIND_CODE_BY_HASH - hash function code 4 HASH_CLIENT_FILE - verify game file integrity 5 GET_LUA_VARIABLE - read Lua UI state 6 API_CHECK - verify imported APIs 7 FIND_DRIVER_BY_NAME - detect kernel drivers 8 CHECK_TIMING_VALUES - timing/teleport consistency
  • str - Name/string payload for module/driver/Lua lookups.
  • data - Expected bytes or hash payload (hex).
  • address / length - Client memory probe location and size (READ_MEMORY).
  • result - Expected comparison result.
  • flags - ScanFlags bitmask (WardenScan.hpp):
Bit Meaning 0x01 FromDatabase - row removed on .reload 0x02 Windows client only 0x04 macOS client only 0x08 run once at initial login 0x20 Maiev default-module scan 0x40 requires MODULE_INITIALIZE first (File/Lua/Timing)
  • penalty - WardenActions value applied on failure (Anticheat.h): 0 log, 1 kick, 2 ban. -1 (255 as uint8) falls back to the global Warden.DefaultPenalty config (mangosd.conf, Warden.DefaultPenalty).
  • build_min / build_max - Client build range this scan applies to.
  • comment - Description.

docs.title: world_safe_locs_facing Table

docs.title: Schema Summary

docs.title: Field Breakdown
docs.text:
• id - Primary Key. Safe-location id from WorldSafeLocs.dbc (same id space as the graveyard ids in game_graveyard_zone).
  • orientation - Facing direction (radians).
